notes: «وساقوا الحديث بمعنى حديث كهمس وإسناده» names Kahmas for the same saying: a variant remark, its route not written (rule 4)
«قال فحججت أنا وحميد بن عبد الرحمن» is the narrator's own account; Humayd and Ma'bad are in the scene, not links (rule 6)
«قالوا» marks the three shaykhs as co-transmitters of Hammad
